origin: Engineering starting points, not validated. min_step_interval_s only stops one foot being given two events of the same kind within 0.4 s (a child's gait cycle, even with a walker, is expected to be longer; check). max_gap_s refuses to bridge missing data longer than 0.1 s. A pass must travel at least 1 m, nearly straight (net/path >= 0.8), so turns are excluded. Confidence is ignored because OpenCap Core provides none.
